title: Being chased, melting, and a weird house in the woods
content: Hi all. I saw this sub referenced in a Mandela Effect sub and wanted to check it out. I've read a bit and the more I see the more convinced I am that I've visited Mall World. Not recently, and mostly as a child. I've seen some of this stuff mentioned by others, but I was curious to hear some other experiences. When I was very young I had what I refer to as my only true "nightmare" and it happened twice, almost exactly the same. I was in a strange, large building and I was being pursued. At one point I hid under a bed, but I was discovered. My tactic was to pretend that I was on the pursuers side. I don't think it worked. While being chased I also recall running down this hallway that was lined with figures. They started to melt down drains that were at the base of each figure. They felt like scarecrows or something. They were related to who/what was pursuing me. The dreams were very similar. (Which is rare/unheard of for me--I don't typically have literal reoccurring dreams. They're more like reoccurring themes which to me feel different.) One distinct difference was that in one, instead of hiding under the bed, I ran to "my room," which was the dream version of my childhood bedroom. I was so scared that I jumped in bed and pulled the covers over my head. I told myself it was just a dream and I could wake up. I remember opening my eyes and seeing a clock in the distance (maybe digital) but the rest of the room was dark. I heard laughter. It was mean and mocking. I realized I wasn't awake so I closed my eyes. I think I woke up as usual after that. The other thing I wanted to mention was a reoccurring location. It's a house deep in some lush, vibrantly green woods. It's tucked away. There might be a waterfall. This was also from my childhood. It felt so real that I would look for the house if ever we were driving though particularly dense woods. But I don't think it's real. And I never went inside. I've seen people share images of the forest and green trees, so I'm curious if anyone knows this house. Have you been inside? I wonder why I don't visit anymore. Thanks for reading. Lots of love.
